Solos was a lost cause. Besieged by Voidborn, expunged of all technology… The only thing he was interested in were the Humptys, and he knew just the one to get.

#

Humpty #16 was having a peaceful day. Birds were chirping, grasses rustling, all was right with the world. The buzzing in his head had gone away. As he took a walk through the woods, he noticed a slight breeze coming from nowhere and spiraling into… what? Downwind he followed it, eventually coming to a small glade with a sort of… pulse coming from it. On his chubby legs he walked along, and what stood before him was a ball of black - but not exactly black, more of a area where light just kind of gave up. The buzzing came back, and he felt drawn to the hole, like a sort of magnetism. It was irresistible, one step, two steps, touching the hole - *pop*. The Humpty was gone, and with it the hole.

"Poor little bastard" were the first words he heard. The second words were, "True. Should we fix him?" shortly followed by a smack to the head and a "There." The buzzing went away. "*Syra, hand me a plasma scalpel, a nanosoldering iron, and a tac processor, please.*" Moments passed, and then he felt a sharp pain in his back. Something slipped inside him, and the pain sort of *reversed*, leaving as quickly as it came. Then, the Humpty *awoke*. Everything around him he noticed, trees, birds, life everywhere, a true paradise. What he noticed most of all was a massive window, looking down upon a planet surrounded by ships.

#

Orocryx smiled as Humpty #16 got to work. "The poor guy's been shorted for processing power since birth. No wonder they were so dumb. That chip should merge with his replication blueprint and be replicated when he reproduces, so no worry there. I even threw in some dimantine to make him essentially indestructible." The Humpty gazed down upon a war-stricken planet through the window of the Starjammer's sprawling garden chamber. However the life flew around him, Orocryx couldn't help but noticed the Humpty looked a bit… morose. He extended a hand to the Humpty. "I am Orocryx. Who are you?" With a voice ringing like a bronze bell, the Humpty spoke. "I have decided on a name for myself."

"I shall be Arbor."

#

Past the Voidborn blockade they snuck, stealth coating proving to be invisible to all their scanners. Twice they were nearly detected, but soon enough they were far enough away to kick the hyperdrive. Arbor had made fast friends with Syra, and the two got to discussing flora and fauna soon enough. From the pilot seat he looked back at the two fondly. "Get ready you two, this is going to be ***fast***!" One switch, two switch, the hyperdrive kicked and off they went to find a new home.
